prompt: Add request-ID middleware and use the ID in the order service logs.
expected_output: A new file under internal/middleware defines a gin.HandlerFunc that generates or forwards a request ID and is registered with r.Use(...) in main.go. The handler reads the ID from the gin context and passes it into the order service as a plain value; the service logs include it, and the service still takes no *gin.Context parameter.

expectations.text: A file under internal/middleware defines a gin.HandlerFunc
The new middleware is registered on the router with .Use(...)
The order service function now takes the request ID as an added parameter
The order service still takes no *gin.Context parameter
Nothing new lands at the repository root
